subject: Banking update + primary contact for Horizon Supplies
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <payments@horizon-supplies.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: payments@horizon-supplies.com
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Updated bank account for Horizon Supplies - effective immediately

Hi Neha,

Quick note from our finance team — effective 02/20/2026 Horizon Supplies is moving payment processing to a new bank account. Please find attached a bank confirmation letter and our updated W-9. We also included a scanned voided check for ACH verification.

New instructions: ACH to account *******4321 at Redwood Community Bank (routing 123456789).

We know you have an open PO for the February shipment (PO #HS-2026-378); we do not want to interrupt remittance for that invoice. Can you confirm your accounts payable team will accept the new details starting with invoices dated 02/20?

Attachments: Horizon_Bank_Letter_20260218.pdf, Horizon_Updated_W9_20260218.pdf, voided_check_horizon.jpg

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Director, Finance Operations
Horizon Supplies Inc.
payments@horizon-supplies.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@horizon-supplies.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated bank account for Horizon Supplies - effective immediately

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads up and for sending the attachments. I’ve looped in Monica from AP and Karthik on vendor onboarding so we can validate the paperwork and the timing. A couple quick asks to avoid payment delays:

- Can you confirm whether the ACH change applies to all existing invoices or only invoices dated on/after 02/20/2026?
- Please confirm the legal name on the bank letter matches the vendor record (Horizon Supplies Inc.).
- If you have a signed vendor setup form on file (PDF), please attach it — that speeds our ERP update.

We’ll treat this as high priority and aim to confirm within 48 hours.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@redwood-supplies.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 11:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated bank account for Horizon Supplies - effective immediately

Neha / Sarah —

Quick note from AP: we require one of the following to process the bank change for an existing vendor: a bank letter on bank letterhead signed by a bank officer, a voided check, or a bank-issued bank verification letter (PDF). The files you sent look good but the bank letter is missing the routing number in the header; the voided check has the MICR line, which helps.

Next steps on our end:
- I’ll tentatively mark the vendor record to switch on 02/20/2026 but will not update payments for any invoice with a payment date before 02/20.
- For PO HS-2026-378, please tell us if the invoice was submitted before 02/20; if so we will process it to the old account. If not, we’ll route to the new account.

Sarah — can you confirm whether the supplier’s AP team submitted the invoice already or will submit next week? If you can reply with the invoice submission date we’ll finalize the routing.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Accounts Payable Lead
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@horizon-supplies.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated bank account for Horizon Supplies - effective immediately

On Thu, Feb 19, 2026 at 8:15 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Sarah — can you confirm whether the supplier’s AP team submitted the invoice already or will submit next week?

Hi Monica — thanks for reviewing. We have not yet submitted the invoice for PO HS-2026-378; it will be created and uploaded to your portal on 02/20/2026. The new bank letter is on RBC letterhead and is signed by the bank officer — I reattached a higher-resolution PDF and included the routing number in the cover page.

Attachments: Horizon_Bank_Letter_20260218.pdf (hi-res)

We confirm the legal name is Horizon Supplies Inc. and the updated ACH should be used for invoices dated 02/20/2026 and later.

Apologies for the confusion on the earlier file — the new letter should have everything AP needs.

Best,
Sarah
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@horizon-supplies.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Updated bank account for Horizon Supplies - effective immediately

All — confirming receipt and update:

- AP has validated the hi-res bank letter and voided check; the routing and account match the vendor record.
- We will switch future payments for invoices dated 02/20/2026 and later to the new account.
- PO HS-2026-378 has not been invoiced yet and will be paid to the new account when the invoice is submitted.
- Internal action: Karthik, please update the vendor contact to reflect Sarah Mills as the primary AP contact (sarah.mills@horizon-supplies.com / +1 415-555-0123) in the vendor master. Monica, please confirm when the ERP change is posted and share the confirmation screenshot or vendor master ID.

Sarah — thank you for the prompt turnaround and for re-sending the hi-res bank letter.

Neha Kapoor
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
